abstract: We establish the global multi-probe Rayleigh–Ritz, Euler-sieve, and fixed-gradient representer theory of the twisted Nyman–Beurling criterion on (1, ∞) for Dirichlet characters modulo q. First, for finite probe sets S coprime to q, we prove F_q(b) := (1/phi(q)) sum_{chi != chi_0} ||1 - sum_{m in S} b_m rho_{m, chi}||_H^2 = (phi(q)-1)/phi(q) - 2 Re sum b_m C_q^{fam}(m) + sum b_m conj(b_n) \widetilde{G}_q^{fam}(m, n), where \widetilde{G}_q^{fam} is a strictly positive definite cotangent matrix; at q = 3 on S = {1, 2, 4}, \widetilde{G}_3^{fam}(1, 4) = ((2 - sqrt(3))/2) G_3^{fam}(1, 1) yields algebraic minimizer ((2 + sqrt(3))/4, -1, 1/2) and minimum energy 1/2 - (6 + 9 sqrt(3))pi/144. Second, we prove M_2(q) := (1/phi(q)) sum_{chi != chi_0} |L(1, chi)|^2 = (phi(q)/q^2) Var_{r in (Z/qZ)^*}(psi_0(r/q)), bounding Lambda_q^{fam}(S) <= 1/M_2(q). Third, the Euler-sieve identity sum_{m|d} mu(m) rho_{m, chi}(y) = rho_{1, chi^{(d q)}}(y) yields G_{2q}^{fam}(1, 1) = (3/2) G_q^{fam}(1, 1) - 2 \widetilde{G}_q^{fam}(1, 2) for odd q >= 3. Fourth, Mellin–Plancherel duality traps untwisted dilates above Delta_q^{untw} > 0 for phi(q) > 2, whereas Krawczyk-certified multiplicative chi(m)-tying escapes below Delta_q^{untw} at K = 6, 8. Fifth, under DFMR pole cancellation sum b_m/m = 0, we derive the constrained minimizer min_{B_q(b)=0} F_q(b), coherent Birch–Stevens norm ||G_{BS, 1}||_H^2 = (pi(p-1)^2/2)cot(pi/p) - p(p-1)G_p^{fam}(1, 1), and Parseval trade-off law. Sixth, sieve S_q := prod_{p|q}(I - D_p) is an outer multiplier on H with bounds prod(1 - p^{-1/2}) <= ||S_q|| <= prod(1 + p^{-1/2}) and inverse mapping N_q^{smooth} onto 1. For principal approximant G_{N, chi_0}^{(q)} = S_q g_N^{(q)}, we establish <1 - G_{N, chi_0}^{(q)}, rho_m>_H = C_m^{(q)}/log N + O((log N)^{-A}) with representer q_{chi_0}^{(q)}(y) := q(y) + psi_q(y) + (q/phi(q)) sum_{d|q} mu(d) rho_d(y), exact telescoping <psi_p, rho_{p^r}>_H = -((log m)^2)/(2m) + (gamma - 1 + (log p)/2)(log m)/m, negativity C_m^{(p)} < C_m < 0, and certified second-order descent.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Major Version 3 upgrade for riemann_hypothesis_22 adding Theorem 6 (Euler-Factor Outer Multiplier Isomorphism, Principal-Character Selberg–Möbius Gradient Representer, Exact Prime-Power Telescoping, Parity Trichotomy of q_chi, and Global Envelope of Ehm's Kernel R_1(x)) and Table 5, incorporating all referee corrections: (1) Proved that S_q := sum_{d|q} mu(d) D_d = prod_{p|q}(I - D_p) is unitarily equivalent via Mellin–Plancherel to the Hardy-space outer multiplier E_q(s) on H^2(Re s > 1/2), with sharp spectral bounds prod_{p|q}(1 - p^{-1/2}) <= ||S_q|| <= prod_{p|q}(1 + p^{-1/2}) and exact inverse S_q^{-1} = sum_{k|q^∞} D_k satisfying S_q N_q^{smooth} = 1 and S_q rho_n = \widetilde{rho}_{n, chi_0}; (2) Proved 1 - G_{N, chi_0}^{(q)} = S_q(N_q^{smooth} - g_N^{(q)}) and <1 - G_{N, chi_0}^{(q)}, rho_m>_H = C_m^{(q)}/log N + O((log N)^{-A}) with explicit Riesz representer q_{chi_0}^{(q)}(y) := q(y) + psi_q(y) + (q/phi(q)) sum_{d|q} mu(d) rho_d(y); (3) Proved exact prime-power telescoping <psi_p, rho_{p^r}>_H = -((log m)^2)/(2m) + (gamma - 1 + (log p)/2)(log m)/m, universal strict negativity C_m^{(p)} < C_m < 0, and the refined O_q(1/m) asymptotic (19g) retaining the -(log m)/(2m) anchor contribution; (4) Certified the prescribed descent G_{N, chi_0}^{(q)\star} := G_{N, chi_0}^{(q)} + (1/log N) sum_{m in S} d_m^* \widetilde{rho}_{m, chi_0} (strictly reducing error whenever D_{q, chi_0}(S) > 0) in Table 5; (5) Proved the Parity Trichotomy of primitive non-principal representers q_chi(y) (Theorem 6d) by half-line Mellin inversion on Re s = c in (1, 2) with rightward shift of the constant term into Re s -> +∞ and leftward shift of the L(1 - s, bar(chi)) term; and (6) Credited Ehm [10, Proposition 2.1] for R_1(x), proved the global envelope -1/(24 x^2) < R_1(x) < 1/(12 x^2) for all x > 0 via w = 1 - a/x in (0, 1) (where F > w^2/2 - w/(12a^2) >= -1/(288a^4)) and Binet's bound (margin >= 153/(72576 a^4) > 0), and distinguished R_{mom}(N, m) = O((1 + log m)exp(-c sqrt(log N))) from R_{tail}(N, m).
title: Multi-Probe Rayleigh-Ritz Optimization, Euler-Factor Sieve Duality, and Global Family Residual Energy in the Twisted Nyman-Beurling Criterion
